text:
Sarah: Quick sync — Silverpine on-prem dry-run tomorrow. Two network blockers left: DNS fallback behavior in air-gapped mode, and outbound egress for cron/metrics. Owners please confirm status and any restrictions we should bake into the runbook. :eyes:

Dinesh: I own egress. Need concrete port + destination list. Do we allow direct internet for updates or force proxy/VPN? Prefer limited proxy to our metrics/updates endpoints.

Taylor: For artifacts/updates we expect a pull model from our internal mirror. If mirror isn't reachable they need pre-seeded images. Which approach is Silverpine planning?

Cheng: Certs/KMS question — if they are fully air-gapped, how will TLS cert rotations and KMS ops work? Do they have HSM or BYOK import path?

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled smoke test tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-cutover (add MFA & access steps).

Sarah: Dinesh — firewall rules I propose (minimal):
```
# allow artifact mirror (HTTPS)
allow tcp 443 to 10.12.0.0/24
# allow metrics to collector via envoy/proxy
allow tcp 15001 to 10.20.5.12
# NTP for time sync
allow udp 123 to 10.30.30.5
```
If they can't reach 10.12/10.20 pools we need pre-seed and file-based metrics.

Taylor: Also: cron jobs for housekeeping currently hit external package repos. We can either pre-seed packages or enable a short egress window. If egress window, suggest rate-limited window 02:00-03:00 local.

Cheng: KMS—they reported BYOK requirement. Options: VPC endpoint to AWS KMS (needs endpoint + iam), or offline import into HSM. I'll draft the offline import steps if they go air-gap.

Dinesh: Action items from my side:
- open PR with sample ACL + iptables snippet
- define allowed CIDRs + ports for smoke
- add proxy fallback notes to runbook
Sarah: can you confirm which images we pre-seed?

Sarah: I'll own the pre-seed list. Planning to put artifacts into s3-private/silverpine and push the following images: runtime v1.12, kernels v2.3, base-agent v3.0. I will add manifest.

Taylor: I'll own the pre-seed job. Simple sync script I will add to ops repo: 
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://s3-private/silverpine/images/ /var/lib/images --recursive --quiet
chown root:root /var/lib/images -R
```
I'll gate by checksum to avoid repeated downloads.

Sarah: One more — customer asked about NTP and cron timezone windows. Recommend the restricted egress window above and document in runbook. Dinesh to update runbook with timing and rate limits.

Dinesh: Will update runbook and push PR by EOD. /cc Cheng for KMS notes.

Cheng: I'll draft the BYOK/offline KMS import playbook and link here by EOD. Also adding cert-rotation manual steps for air-gap.

Taylor: Quick question — do we need a fallback DNS list baked into agent config if internal DNS resolves to nothing? We can add static hosts in /etc/hosts as fallback.

Sarah: Yes — include static fallback seeds in agent config and a short script to swap hosts on boot if DNS fails. I'll include sample snippet in the pre-seed manifest.

Dinesh: Sounds good. I'll coordinate with networking to ensure the ACLs are staged before the smoke.

Sarah: Thanks everyone — big help. :thumbsup: I'll follow up with the pre-seed manifest link once uploaded.
__notes: This thread is a short cross-team coordination about private on-prem rollout networking and air-gap blockers for a single customer (Silverpine).
